content: No product named 'Cairni' is findable in web search (results resolve to Cairn.info the French scholarly portal, and codewithcairn.ai a coding assistant). The actual named ancestor of this product class is Andrej Karpathy's 'LLM Wiki' pattern (April 2026): compile sources into interlinked markdown entity pages with [[wikilinks]] up front, then query the compiled artifact instead of doing chunk retrieval at query time. Stack is 'raw sources -> wiki -> schema'; sources/ is immutable and never modified by the LLM; wiki/ holds entity pages plus index.md and log.md (chronological record of ingests, queries, lint passes); AGENTS.md holds conventions. Three workflows: ingest, query, maintain. Maintain = lint, avoid duplicate pages, update existing canonical pages rather than creating clutter. Implementations: llm-wiki-compiler (Klore), CodeWiki, LoreKeeper. NexusWiki's schema maps 1:1 onto this pattern.
